title: Broken Halo
description: A simple cosmetic pack that turns a renamed feather into a shattered, floating halo. Clean, subtle, and iconic with a broken divine look for your character.
body:
**This resource pack adds a floating, fractured celestial ring above your character, featuring a shattered and incomplete structure with a broken, uneven design.**  

![Broken Halo in-game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5eaa2ce9ff8605eb1cb5f3391989e710fde5b383.png)

Instead of a perfect ring, the Halo appears fractured and incomplete, creating a subtle celestial look with a slightly corrupted divine aesthetic. It stays visually clean and minimal, but the broken structure gives it a stronger identity and a more unique presence in-game.

The effect is purely cosmetic and does not affect gameplay, stats, or mechanics. It is designed to work through simple item renaming, keeping it fully vanilla-friendly and lightweight.

A simple way to add a distinctive visual detail above your character without clutter or complexity.

_Simply rename a feather to “Halo” in an anvil to use it. Then put the feather on your head or wherever you like to display it._

Note: To display the halo on your head, you can use a hat datapack such as:
https://modrinth.com/datapack/hat-datapack
